config.minecraftwallpapercreater.title: Minecraft Wallpaper Creator
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.capture: Frame rate used while capturing from rendered frames.
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.hide_hu: Temporarily hide the HUD before the first frame is captured.
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.auto_bl: Generate transition frames from the tail of the capture back to the head.
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.blend_f: How many generated transition frames are appended to the loop playlist.
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.playbac: Frame rate used by the external player / exported loop; higher is smoother but generates more frames.
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.export_: Choose the final export container / codec, or keep only the PNG sequence.
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.rife_th: How many Rust worker threads are used for parallel RIFE interpolation. Set 0 to use the automatic safe scheduler, which leaves CPU and memory headroom for the game and system.
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.max_mem: Approximate memory budget for the Rust RIFE worker. Lower values reduce peak memory usage by limiting parallel workers.
config.minecraftwallpapercreater.hint: Use F8 to start capture. This config page is also available from Mod Menu.
